about_item: 【Made of Durable Stainless Steel】 Feedoo lick mat for dogs is crafted from double wall 304 stainless steel, not silicone or plastic. This premium-grade material is chew-resistant, durable, and naturally hygienic-ideal for dogs who need more than just a toy. US Patented Designed for daily enrichment and built to last.

【Calm Every Meal】 Use this slow feeder for dogs to help reduce bloating, promote better digestion, and ease anxiety. The textured surface encourages soothing licking behavior that keeps your pup calm and focused during mealtime, training, or stressful moments like grooming and thunderstorms.

【Anxiety Relief in Any Situation】 This versatile crate lick mat doubles as a calming aid during grooming, bathing, travel, or crate time. Spread peanut butter, yogurt, or wet food to keep your dog mentally engaged and emotionally settled-perfect for separation anxiety or daily enrichment.

【Non-Slip Base, Effortless Clean-Up】 The non-slip base keep the mat steady on any floor, more heavy duty than other silicone mat. Unlike silicone mats that trap food and odors, this dishwasher safe lick mat is easy to rinse, won’t retain smells, and stays spotless meal after meal. Whether hand-washed or tossed in the dishwasher, Feedoo is built to stay clean and hygienic with minimal effort.

【One Mat, For Medium & Large Dogs】 Measuring 9.65" x 9.65" x 0.38", this licking mat is perfectly sized to suit medium, large dogs breeds, and even heavy chewers. Designed for peanut butter and treats, it provides a safe and rewarding experience for every stage of life-whether for calming enrichment or fun treat time, it’s a daily essential.

summary.text: Customers find the stainless steel lick mat easy to clean in the dishwasher and appreciate its durability, with one noting it's better than plastic versions. The product effectively slows down eating, particularly for young dogs, and stays in place on various surfaces including wood floors. Customers consider it great for pets, with one mentioning it's perfect for RV use. While customers find it well worth the money, opinions on value are mixed.

insights.summary: Customers find the pet placemat easy to clean, noting that it washes nicely in the dishwasher.
